objective_for_doctor:
Age: 17
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: loss of consciousness

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had loss of consciousness. I’ve also been coughing up blood, and I’ve been having significant shortness of breath and pain.
Where exactly is the pain located, and what does it feel like (e.g., sharp, dull, pressure)?
My pain is sharp. It’s on the right and left side of my chest, on the right and left posterior chest wall, and also around my left scapula and right and left scapula.
Did these symptoms start suddenly, or have they been building up gradually over time?
I don’t know. The pain’s pace at which it appears is 1 out of 10.
Have you had any recent long trips, surgeries, periods of bed rest, or noticed any swelling or pain in your legs?

Yes. I had surgery within the last month, and I’ve been unable to move or get up for more than 3 consecutive days within the last 4 weeks. I’ve also traveled out of the country to North America in the last 4 weeks. I have swelling in the posterior aspect of my ankle (right).
